summary: OpenAI and Oracle will let OCI customers apply existing Oracle Universal Credits toward OpenAI models and Codex, with availability starting in coming weeks.

categories.reason: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is the platform through which OpenAI models and Codex will be purchased and distributed, making the platform relationship itself the announcement.
categories.quote: In the coming weeks, Oracle customers will be able to apply eligible Oracle Universal Credits toward OpenAI models and Codex through OCI.

practices.reason: A new purchasing path via Oracle credits changes procurement but not the technical integration surface for engineering teams already using the API.
practices.quote: This gives customers a path to access OpenAI models under their existing purchasing workflow and cloud commitment.
